about: What each measured Octatrack module adds to the longest frame interrupt of a reading, in percent of a frame: `use` on each track or slot it takes, `wake` once when it wakes from resting (3 % when not measured; 0 where `use` was read on a first pick from rest, which holds it, or where the module has no ColdFire hooks to wake). The site sends this table with every module set (MWMS v2, sdk/runtime/loader/set_package.h); the base judges every module pick by the longest frame it would play, against mw_frame_line (status.c). A module not listed: a machine is charged its measured meter cost or its price (12 % when it names none), an effect nothing, and a wake 3 %. Measure with `npm run device -- guard` on a unit: the longest frame over 8 s on the same Part before and after one pick, a machine on an empty track (on one that plays a sample it saves that render and reads low). A module adds more to the longest frame than to the mean (Amiga +26.7 against +20). Prefer a reading on the newest base; on one base, the larger. A negative reading counts 0. Base-owned: a module's own folder never changes for it.
